bootstrap.method: paired seed bootstrap; calibration averages relations within seed, comparison estimates each relation separately
bootstrap.interval_interpretation: descriptive exploratory intervals; the four-seed comparison is not a high-power confirmation

primary.score_target: feedback.utility_target for the selected action only
primary.direction: negative favors linear prediction on selected labels

calibration.exploratory_scope: seed bootstrap with relations averaged within seed; this measures selected-label prediction only and does not identify unchosen-action outcomes
